<!-- Tarjeta 2 — Arquitectura: con copia vs sin copia -->

##

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5.6
#| fig-align: center
library(ggplot2)

caja <- function(x, y, w, h, fill, border = NA) {
  annotate("rect", xmin = x - w / 2, xmax = x + w / 2,
           ymin = y - h / 2, ymax = y + h / 2,
           fill = fill, color = border, linewidth = 0.4)
}
flecha <- function(x1, x2, y, col = "#64748b") {
  annotate("segment", x = x1, xend = x2, y = y, yend = y,
           color = col, linewidth = 0.5,
           arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.12, "inches")))
}

ggplot() +
  # ── Lado izquierdo: el patrón con copia ──
  annotate("text", x = 2.6, y = 5.9, label = "Hasta ahora: con copia",
           color = "#1e293b", size = 4.6, fontface = "bold") +
  caja(1.2, 4.3, 1.9, 1.1, "#1e293b") +
  annotate("text", x = 1.2, y = 4.3, label = "Lakehouse\n(tablas Delta)",
           color = "white", size = 3, fontface = "bold", lineheight = 0.95) +
  flecha(2.25, 3.05, 4.3) +
  annotate("text", x = 2.65, y = 4.72, label = "pipeline\nde sync",
           color = "#64748b", size = 2.5, lineheight = 0.95) +
  caja(4.0, 4.3, 1.9, 1.1, "#64748b") +
  annotate("text", x = 4.0, y = 4.3, label = "sistema de\nserving aparte",
           color = "white", size = 3, fontface = "bold", lineheight = 0.95) +
  annotate("label", x = 4.0, y = 3.52, label = "copia de los datos",
           fill = "#fee2e2", color = "#b91c1c", size = 2.6,
           label.padding = unit(0.18, "lines"), label.size = 0) +
  flecha(5.05, 5.45, 4.3) +
  caja(6.1, 4.3, 1.3, 1.1, "#f1f5f9", "#cbd5e1") +
  annotate("text", x = 6.1, y = 4.3, label = "app /\ndashboard",
           color = "#1e293b", size = 2.8, lineheight = 0.95) +
  annotate("text", x = 3.6, y = 2.55,
           label = "dos sistemas · dos copias · dos gobernanzas\ny un pipeline de sincronización que mantener",
           color = "#b91c1c", size = 3, lineheight = 1.05, fontface = "italic") +
  # ── Lado derecho: Lakehouse//RT ──
  annotate("text", x = 10.2, y = 5.9, label = "Con Lakehouse//RT: sin copia",
           color = "#1e293b", size = 4.6, fontface = "bold") +
  caja(8.6, 4.3, 2.1, 1.1, "#1e293b") +
  annotate("text", x = 8.6, y = 4.3,
           label = "tablas Delta / Iceberg\nUnity Catalog",
           color = "white", size = 2.9, fontface = "bold", lineheight = 0.95) +
  flecha(9.75, 10.25, 4.3, "#e8854a") +
  caja(11.2, 4.3, 1.9, 1.1, "#FFA166") +
  annotate("text", x = 11.2, y = 4.3, label = "Lakehouse//RT\n(motor Reyden)",
           color = "#1e293b", size = 3, fontface = "bold", lineheight = 0.95) +
  flecha(12.25, 12.65, 4.3, "#e8854a") +
  caja(13.3, 4.3, 1.3, 1.1, "#f1f5f9", "#cbd5e1") +
  annotate("text", x = 13.3, y = 4.3, label = "app /\ndashboard",
           color = "#1e293b", size = 2.8, lineheight = 0.95) +
  annotate("text", x = 10.9, y = 2.55,
           label = "las queries corren directo sobre tus tablas,\ngobernadas por Unity Catalog",
           color = "#0d9488", size = 3, lineheight = 1.05, fontface = "italic") +
  annotate("segment", x = 7.3, xend = 7.3, y = 1.9, yend = 6.1,
           color = "#e2e8f0", linewidth = 0.6) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 14.1), ylim = c(1.9, 6.4), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(caption = "⚡ Spark de Ideas · mauroloprete.github.io/mauroloprete") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#f8fafc", color = NA),
        plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 15),
        plot.caption = element_text(color = "#94a3b8", size = 7,
                                    hjust = 1, face = "italic"))
```

[Los números del anuncio]{.kicker} [BETA]{style="background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; font-size: 0.45em; font-weight: 800; padding: 0.15em 0.6em; border-radius: 6px; vertical-align: middle; margin-left: 0.6em;"}

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 4.4
#| fig-align: center
tiles <- data.frame(
  x = c(1.6, 5.0, 8.4),
  grande = c("desde 10 ms", "sub-100 ms", "16×"),
  sub = c("en datasets chicos",
          "sosteniendo 12.000 QPS\n(queries por segundo)",
          "contra stacks de serving\nespecializados"),
  fill = c("#FFA166", "#1e293b", "#593196"),
  col_grande = c("#1e293b", "white", "white"),
  col_sub = c("#7c2d12", "#cbd5e1", "#e2e8f0")
)

ggplot(tiles) +
  geom_tile(aes(x = x, y = 1, fill = fill),
            width = 3.0, height = 2.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(x = x, y = 1.5, label = grande, color = col_grande),
            size = 7.4, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(x = x, y = 0.55, label = sub, color = col_sub),
            size = 2.9, lineheight = 1.05, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_color_identity() +
  annotate("text", x = 5.0, y = -0.75,
           label = "la doc, más conservadora, promete sub-segundo",
           color = "#64748b", size = 3.1, fontface = "italic") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.2, 10.2), ylim = c(-1.2, 2.5), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(caption = "⚡ Spark de Ideas · mauroloprete.github.io/mauroloprete") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#f8fafc", color = NA),
        plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 15),
        plot.caption = element_text(color = "#94a3b8", size = 7,
                                    hjust = 1, face = "italic"))
```

<!-- Tarjeta 4 — Boxplots del bench (lee el CSV de la corrida si existe) -->

##

[Mis mediciones, desde fuera]{.kicker}

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5.2
#| fig-align: center
rutas <- c("latencias.csv",
           "~/Documents/spark-de-ideas-labs/tips/lakehouse-rt/bench/results/latencias.csv")
rutas <- path.expand(rutas)
ruta <- rutas[file.exists(rutas)][1]

tipo_map <- c(REALTIME = "Lakehouse//RT",
              SERVERLESS = "SQL Serverless", PRO = "SQL Serverless",
              SERVERLESS_CACHE = "SQL Serverless (cache)")
colores <- c("Lakehouse//RT" = "#FFA166",
             "SQL Serverless" = "#64748b",
             "SQL Serverless (cache)" = "#593196")
query_map <- c(q1_estado_cliente = "Q1 · lookup puntual",
               q2_top_productos  = "Q2 · top productos 24 h",
               q3_panel_segmento = "Q3 · join por segmento")

if (!is.na(ruta)) {
  d <- read.csv(ruta)
  d <- d[d$estado == "SUCCEEDED" & d$query != "baseline_select_1" &
           !is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$total_time_ms))), ]
  d$total_time_ms <- as.numeric(d$total_time_ms)
  lbl <- unname(tipo_map[d$tipo])
  d$wh <- factor(lbl, levels = intersect(names(colores), unique(lbl)))
  d$q <- factor(query_map[d$query], levels = unname(query_map))

  ggplot(d, aes(x = factor(concurrencia), y = total_time_ms, fill = wh)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.75, outlier.shape = NA, color = "#1e293b",
                 linewidth = 0.35, width = 0.62,
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.72, preserve = "single")) +
    facet_wrap(~q, nrow = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colores, name = NULL) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(x = "requests en paralelo",
         y = "latencia server-side (ms, escala log10)",
         caption = "⚡ Spark de Ideas · mauroloprete.github.io/mauroloprete") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#f8fafc", color = NA),
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#f8fafc", color = NA),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(color = "#1e293b", face = "bold"),
          axis.text = element_text(color = "#1e293b"),
          axis.title = element_text(color = "#64748b", size = 9),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          plot.caption = element_text(color = "#94a3b8", size = 7,
                                      hjust = 1, face = "italic"))
} else {
  ggplot() +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 1, xmax = 11, ymin = 0.5, ymax = 4.5,
             fill = NA, color = "#FFA166", linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
    annotate("text", x = 6, y = 2.9, label = "Boxplots del bench",
             color = "#1e293b", size = 6, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text", x = 6, y = 2.0,
             label = "pendiente de la corrida: python3 bench/bench.py (tres series)",
             color = "#64748b", size = 3.4, family = "mono") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 12), ylim = c(0, 5), expand = FALSE) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#f8fafc", color = NA))
}
```

<!-- Tarjeta 5 — Pricing -->

##

[¿Cuánto cuesta?]{.kicker}

| Qué | Detalle |
|---|---|
| SKU propio | factura en su propia línea de producto; en las system tables se ve separado |
| Descuento de la Beta | no baja el precio: baja la emisión de DBUs un 30%. Consumís 10, te facturan 7 |
| Vigencia del descuento | hasta el 31 de enero de 2027 |
| DBU | la unidad de cómputo con la que Databricks factura |

[Pricing de la Beta (doc oficial) · el feature set puede cambiar antes del GA]{.tabla-nota}

<!-- Tarjeta 6 — Cuándo sí, cuándo no + CTA -->

##

[¿Cuándo sí, cuándo no?]{.kicker}

::: {.check-list}
**1.** Serving de analítica a apps o dashboards con mucha concurrencia: Lakehouse//RT, y la ventana del descuento es el momento barato de probarlo.

**2.** Lookups puntuales de features: mirá antes el Online Feature Store con Lakebase.

**3.** BI interno sin exigencia sub-segundo: el serverless de siempre ya te sobra.

**4.** No lo confundas con el Real-time mode de Structured Streaming: eso es procesamiento de streams, esto es serving de queries.
:::
